newsitem.title: USA: Network General to buy Cinco, take charges.
newsitem.headline: Network General to buy Cinco, take charges.

text.p: Network General Corp said it agreed to buy privately-held Cinco Networks Inc for an initial payment of $27 million, plus the possibility of contingent payments one and two years after the acquisition.

Network General said it will account for the transaction, expected to close by the end of August, as a purchase and will record charges for in process research and development and related expenses in the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 1997.
For the first quarter ended June 30, Network General reported net income of $0.16 a share or $6.97 million on sales of $43.0 million.
